# Qasr-e-Mussarat Marquee

> Premium wedding and event marquee in Haroonabad hosting Mehndi, Baraat, Walima, and corporate dinners for up to 1,000 guests.

Qasr-e-Mussarat Marquee is a flagship event venue offering full-service hosting — catering menus, decor add-ons, staff, and on-site coordination. Customers can check live availability, request bookings, schedule a venue visit, and purchase event stationery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, live availability, and featured services.
- [Venues](/venues): Halls and marquee spaces with capacity and amenities.
- [Booking](/booking): Request a date, pick menu items and add-ons, view pricing.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from past weddings, mehndi, and corporate events.
- [About](/about): Story, location, and what makes the venue different.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, and address for inquiries.
- [Meeting](/meeting): Schedule an in-person venue visit.
- [Digital Products](/digital-products): Wedding stationery and downloadable templates.
